nodes.label: website-care
nodes.blurb: PM playbook for WebsiteCare — Karol's recurring site-maintenance product.

nodes.label: /blueprint
nodes.blurb: Plan a client's website — run the intake interview, generate the client workbook, or digest returned answers into the Website Blueprint

meta.arguments: <slug> [workbook|digest] — e.g. "zemvelo" (live interview), "zemvelo workbook" (generate the fillable workbook), "zemvelo digest" (parse returned answers). No argument lists clients with plans.

nodes.label: /briefs
nodes.blurb: Turn a client's search-demand queue into evidence-backed content briefs, ranked and cadence-aware, for Karol to pick

meta.arguments: <slug> [--month YYYY-MM] [--limit N] — e.g. /briefs mineralife. No argument lists sites with data.

nodes.label: /care
nodes.blurb: Run the WebsiteCare cycle for a client — weekly audit + fix picklist, or compile the monthly care report

meta.arguments: <slug> [report] — e.g. "zemvelo" (weekly audit), "zemvelo report" (monthly draft). No argument lists clients on care plans.

nodes.label: /client
nodes.blurb: Activate a client/brand context pack for this session (voice, claims, compliance, tokens, stack, gates)

meta.arguments: <slug> — e.g. zemvelo, artist-house, tallkarol. No argument lists available packs.

nodes.label: /clock
nodes.blurb: Timeclock — clock in/out of billable work for a client/project, check what's running, or backfill a session

meta.arguments: in <client> [project] | out [client] | status | log <client> [YYYY-MM] — e.g. "in gdi tba", "out", "status"

nodes.label: /estimate
nodes.blurb: Estimate a future project from ledger history — comparables, calibrated p50/p80 range, and three price options under the raise-rate-work-less philosophy

meta.arguments: [client] <what the work is> — e.g. "gdi uwd-style preprod build, 6 templates" or "new client, shopify theme refresh"

nodes.label: /follow-up
nodes.blurb: Turn this conversation's follow-ups into tallkarol CRM tasks, calendar events, or both — numbered proposal → Karol approves → submit

meta.arguments: [client] [--project <slug>] [what to follow up on] — e.g. "gdi", "gdi chase hero images by friday", or nothing to use this repo's pin and this session's next steps

nodes.label: /invoice
nodes.blurb: Draft a client invoice from the timeclock — purser reconciles the period, Karol picks fixes, then the invoice renders from the template

meta.arguments: <client> [YYYY-MM] — e.g. "gdi", "gdi 2026-08". Month defaults to the current one; period starts after the last recorded invoice.

nodes.label: /leftoff
nodes.blurb: The where-I-left-off board — leave a post-it on this chat, read what's waiting on you, or search everything you've ever said

meta.arguments: <text> | list | search <words> | history [--since 7d] | dismiss <ref> | pin <ref> | agent <type> — e.g. "waiting on Ola's copy", "list", "search elementor nav"

nodes.label: /log-session
nodes.blurb: Log agent hours for a client into the tallkarol CRM timesheet — proposal (client, project, summary, concurrency-weighted hours, the conversations behind them) → Karol approves → submit

meta.arguments: [client] [--project <slug>] [--since <ISO>] — e.g. "gdi", "gdi --project gdi-wordpress", or nothing to use this repo's .claude/client pin

nodes.label: /punchlist
nodes.blurb: Turn an email, a doc or a transcript into a tallkarol CRM punch list — numbered items → Karol approves → every item becomes a task.

nodes.label: /session-log
nodes.blurb: Draft what a conversation did — one invoice-voice line per session from its transcript, edited files, commits and metered hours; stored locally, pushed to the CRM

meta.arguments: "[ref | --sweep] — e.g. nothing (this session), \"73ff9397\", or \"--sweep\" to catch up the last week"

nodes.label: /spec-sheet
nodes.blurb: Spec sheet for a codebase — components, versions, deploy, env names, git — read from the files and stored per client in the CRM; rerun to update

nodes.label: Agent meter
nodes.blurb: Records agent-active turns and token usage per client across every session, so hours exist before anyone tries to remember them.

meta.cadence: every prompt, stop, subagent start/stop, session end

nodes.label: Left-off reporter
nodes.blurb: Reports what every conversation is doing to the CRM board — working, waiting on Karol, blocked on a permission prompt, parked.

meta.cadence: same five events, plus permission prompts
meta.hook events: Notification, SessionEnd, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, UserPromptSubmit

nodes.label: Session summarizer
nodes.blurb: At session end a headless call turns the transcript into one invoice-voice line, while the transcript is still on disk.

meta.cadence: session end, plus a weekly sweep

nodes.label: Care cycle
nodes.blurb: Read-only audit → fix picklist → Karol picks → approved ops only, backup-first.

nodes.label: Daily scout
nodes.blurb: Mines the day's work for a search-relevant nugget. Zero good nuggets is a correct outcome — it never invents one.

meta.cadence: daily, or right after a notable fix

nodes.label: Demand briefs
nodes.blurb: Reads the ranked search-opportunity queue and pitches cadence-aware briefs against the claim bank.

nodes.label: Month-end close
nodes.blurb: Purser reconciles the period, Karol picks the fixes, then the invoice renders from the timeclock.

nodes.label: HARVESTER
nodes.blurb: Run once when a project ships: one mining pass produces one report every content lane reads.

meta.stages: MINE → MINE REPORT → PITCH → DISPATCH → QA GATES
